ReactCommand.description: A tapback on a bubble; `remove` takes it back.
ReactCommand.title: ReactCommand

SaveContact.description: The user tapped the agent's contact card to save it.
SaveContact.title: SaveContact

AgentMessage.description: A bubble that was sent. Recorded, never routed.
AgentMessage.title: AgentMessage

CallOptOut.description: They'd rather not talk on the phone. The agent stops offering a call.
CallOptOut.title: CallOptOut

ContactCard.description:
The agent's contact card (a .vcf), sent whenever its name is set or changed. The
user's phone only shows the new name once they tap to save it (ContactSaved).
ContactCard.title: ContactCard

ContactSaved.description:
The user saved the agent's contact card. Sets what their phone calls the agent.

It happens on their phone, so the agent never learns of it: not routed, not in any
prompt. Only the phone's own display uses it.
ContactSaved.title: ContactSaved

DeviceTimezone.description:
Their browser's timezone. No longer sent or used: a texting assistant couldn't know it.
Kept so older rows still load.
DeviceTimezone.title: DeviceTimezone

Forgot.description:
The agent forgot a fact, by its number. The pipeline fills in `fact` and drops the
event if there is no such fact.
Forgot.title: Forgot

InboxItem.description: One inbox message as seen at connect time: headers and Gmail's snippet, no body.
InboxItem.title: InboxItem

JobAsked.description: The job needs something from them. It waits until it's told or cancelled.
JobAsked.title: JobAsked

JobTold.description: Their answer, or anything else they said the job should know, passed on to it.
JobTold.title: JobTold

Medium.description: Which medium has the floor: voice while a call is connected, text otherwise.
Medium.title: Medium

Reaction.description:
A tapback (❤️ 👍 😂 …) on a bubble, by either side. The user's route: a 👍 on
"want me to call?" is an answer. The agent's are recorded only.
Reaction.title: Reaction

Remembered.description: The agent remembered a fact. The pipeline fills in `fact_id` and drops a repeat.
Remembered.title: Remembered

ReplyDue.description: Time to check whether to reply. Submitted by the text medium after a delay; never stored.
ReplyDue.title: ReplyDue

ReplyStarted.description:
The agent started replying to everything up to and including event `through_seq`.
Stored, so "is anything waiting for a reply?" is a question about the log.
ReplyStarted.title: ReplyStarted

SlotChanged.description:
The agent recorded a name or the help need. The pipeline fills in `old` and drops the
event if the value did not change.
SlotChanged.title: SlotChanged

StepSetAside.description:
They'd rather not do a setup step (a name for you, theirs, what they need, Google). It
stops being asked for; it comes back only if they bring it up.
StepSetAside.title: StepSetAside

TimezoneLearned.description:
Where they are, in time: from their Google Calendar's setting, or because they said. What
they said wins over the calendar; the pipeline drops a calendar zone after one they said.
TimezoneLearned.title: TimezoneLearned

ToolCall.description: A tool the agent (or a background job) used, kept compact: no raw payloads, no secrets.
ToolCall.title: ToolCall

TranscriptPartial.description:
A live caption: `text` is the turn's full transcript so far (replace, don't append).
`final` closes the turn; the VoiceUtterance event with the same turn_id follows.
TranscriptPartial.title: TranscriptPartial

TzSource.description:
How we know their timezone. Only what a texting assistant could really know: their
Google Calendar's setting, or what they told us (which wins; they may be travelling).
TzSource.title: TzSource

VoiceNote.description: A voice message the user sent. Handled like a text: `transcript` is what they said.
VoiceNote.title: VoiceNote

VoiceUtterance.description: One turn of speech. Recorded, never routed. On GPT-Live the boundary is inferred.
VoiceUtterance.title: VoiceUtterance

WireEvent.description: The event envelope as the browser sees it, with the payload typed as the full union.
WireEvent.title: WireEvent
